about_the_game:
Step into a deadly game fraught with perils

"The Joker's Game" will transport you to a mansion crafted by a mysterious organization, where everything operates under the brutal rule of "survival of the fittest, annihilation of the weak." The game offers lethal, upgraded versions of classic childhood games: you must fight for survival across various challenges. Can you trust your companions here? Even your most trusted ally might strike you down from behind with a fatal blow!

Puzzles and games combine to create an exhilarating experience

"The Joker's Game" is no mere orgy of violence—every challenge is a test of wit and strategy! In "Sugar Art Challenge," players must draw intricate patterns with chocolate sauce; in "Maze Escape," players must decode visual illusions to find a way out. Additionally, the game incorporates multi-dimensional puzzle mechanics: voting strategy, using "minority rule" votes to eliminate rivals and leverage psychological warfare to manipulate situations; teamwork, sharing clues with temporary allies but watching for betrayals.

An enthralling storyline leads you to escape to freedom.

"You think winning the prize will set you free? This is just the beginning of a much larger conspiracy..." The game reveals the dark truth behind the amusement park through multi-threaded narratives: among the participants are debt-ridden gamblers, undercover police officers hiding their identities, and elites attempting to atone for their sins. As the plot unfolds, players will gradually uncover the true motives of the organizers - whether it's a wealthy tycoon's entertainment gambling, a front for human experiments, or a cruel metaphor for class society. Your choices will influence the branching outcomes of the story.

In the hidden levels, eerie scenes unveil the secrets of the laboratory. "Here, fairness is the greatest lie, and survival is the only rule." Join "The Joker's Game" now to uncover the truth or become a sacrifice to the conspiracy.

  • OS: macOS 10.14 High Sierra
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1 GB VRAM & OpenGL 4.1
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 40 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: macOS Sonoma 14 or above
  • Processor: Apple M1 or above
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Discrete graphics card or M-series integrated graphics
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 60 GB available space

short_description: "The Joker's Game" is an FMV crime battle royale. Jack, drowning in debt, joins a lethal game. Critical choices, even small ones, shape outcomes. Outwit rivals, uncover truths, or perish? Every move decides survival... or the deadly prize.
